items.body:
https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/b3fa4790b7fe45c134bc884871824a512f4fd6a3/crates/bevy_log/Cargo.toml#L18

tracing-subscriber-0.3.12 has compile issue. 
However in bevy_log it's version written in 0.3.1~. Maybe 0.3.11 had no issue but it automatically get up to date version. 
I think it would be better to specify version eg. 0.3.11

```
error[E0407]: method `event_enabled` is not a member of trait `Subscriber`
   --> C:\Users\---\.cargo\registry\src\github.com-1ecc6299db9ec823\tracing-subscriber-0.3.12\src\layer\layered.rs:142:5
    |
142 | /     fn event_enabled(&self, event: &Event<'_>) -> bool {
143 | |         if self.layer.event_enabled(event, self.ctx()) {
144 | |             // if the outer layer enables the event, ask the inner subscriber.
145 | |             self.inner.event_enabled(event)
...   |
149 | |         }
150 | |     }
    | |_____^ not a member of trait `Subscriber`

error[E0407]: method `event_enabled` is not a member of trait `tracing_core::Subscriber`
   --> C:\Users\---\.cargo\registry\src\github.com-1ecc6299db9ec823\tracing-subscriber-0.3.12\src\fmt\mod.rs:401:5
    |
401 | /     fn event_enabled(&self, event: &Event<'_>) -> bool {
402 | |         self.inner.event_enabled(event)
403 | |     }
    | |_____^ not a member of trait `tracing_core::Subscriber`
```

PS. the error is  ```method `event_enabled` is not a member of trait `Subscriber` ```.  tracing-subscriber-0.3.12 has dependency of  tracin-core-0.1.27 but it has no 'event_enabled' function. But 0.1.28 has. I think this is actually tokio's fault with upload crates but sepecifying the version in bevy_log needed also.
